title: Final Expression for B
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for B in terms of q, R, m, and omega.

title: Final Expression for u'_0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the zero component of the particle's 4-velocity as measured by the observer.

title: Final Expression for du'_0/dtau
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the derivative of the zero component of the 4-velocity with respect to proper time.

title: Energy Change Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain how the energy of the particle can change in the context of the problem.

title: Use of Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Lorentz factor in the context of relativistic velocities.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the expressions for velocities and forces.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods or checks to reinforce their solution.
